correctness.rationale: The intersection event for k designated defects forces nk columns absent and k independent nonempty rows on n-k other columns, giving exact factorial moments and PGF. Pairwise negative covariance yields Var(W)<=E(W). A fixed-k ratio bound proves Poisson factorial moment limits for every convergent positive intensity; a first-moment bound handles zero intensity; Chebyshev handles diverging intensity. The two windows and intervening phase follow by elementary asymptotics. A standalone exhaustive verifier checked all 66066 teams up to n=4 and exact rational probabilities.
